name: Firefox
summary: Sends technical and interaction data to Mozilla by default, plus a separate Daily Usage Ping with de-identified information that Firefox is in use. Both can be turned off in settings.

optOut.instructions: In Firefox settings, clear 'Allow Firefox to send technical and interaction data to Mozilla'. The Daily Usage Ping is a separate opt-out in settings and is not affected by that checkbox. The on/off state is stored in a per-profile file, so this app does not check it.
